production_source_identity.source_facts: BF16 Add/Mul uses two vec4 inputs, one vec4 output, 256 threads, and 1024 elements per tail-free CTA.

production_non_duration_validation.interpretation: The canonical non-duration counters show that the saturated tail-free source remains a compulsory-DRAM stream even though its nominal 6 MiB 2R1W footprint is smaller than the physical 8 MiB L2.

counter_validation.interpretation: The numbered per-invocation report preserves the exact 2:1 global-byte ratio within initialization/sink traffic and has zero L2 hits; DNoC request counts agree with 128-byte physical lines within 179 requests.

selected_service.selection_rule: minimum campaign median across the saturated 832- and 1664-CTA full-chip points
selected_service.saturation_rule: 832 CTAs provide eight four-wave CTAs per each of 104 APs, equal to the documented 32-wave-per-AP residency ceiling; doubling to 1664 changes the campaign median by less than one percent
selected_service.composition: For an exact 2:1 stream, read_bytes/read_capacity equals write_bytes/write_capacity; their maximum is the one coupled service time.

selected_partial_resident_service.selection_rule: campaign median at the independently measured 416-CTA point
selected_partial_resident_service.residency_rule: 416 CTAs provide exactly four four-wave CTAs on each of 104 APs; the selected capacity is a conservative service for launches with at least four resident CTAs per AP and below the separately characterized eight-CTA saturation cohort
selected_partial_resident_service.composition: For an exact 2:1 stream, read_bytes/read_capacity equals write_bytes/write_capacity; their maximum is the one coupled service time.

applicability.cache_scope: compulsory-DRAM stream; the probe working set exceeds L2 and canonical non-duration counters validate the same saturated source at a nominal 6 MiB footprint with only 4.08-4.69% L2 hits

decision.reason: The workload-independent tail-free vec4 2R1W stream is stable at the measured four-CTA and eight-CTA resident cohorts, has zero measured L2 hits at the counter-validation point, preserves physical read/write traffic, and supplies only typed byte-service capacities. Canonical non-duration counters independently validate compulsory DRAM traffic for the same saturated source below nominal L2 capacity.

excluded_conclusions: a replacement for generic DRAM read or write capacity
scalar, vec8, non-BF16, or tail-bearing paths
an inference of physical L2 capacity from the nominal stream footprint
